name: Voices from the Sea
source:
Follow the story of a young boy, Cantus as he meets Maris, the mysterious girl by the sea - an experience that will change his life forever.

[From [url=http://zeiva.net/games/voices.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
跟随少年坎图斯的故事，见证他遇见海边神秘少女玛丽丝——这段经历将永远改变他的人生。

[来源：[url=http://zeiva.net/games/voices.html]官方网站[/url]]
